arena: [회피] Grounding Totem absorbs harmful single-target spells aimed at allies within 30 yds for 3 sec. Drop it right before an enemy CC cast finishes.
[생존기] Astral Shift reduces damage taken by 40% for 12 sec. Use it first when the enemy pops burst cooldowns and unloads on you.

[생존기] With Burrow, you go underground for 5 sec, can't be attacked, break movement impairing effects, and knock up enemies within 6 yds when it ends. Use it to dodge burst when your other defensives are down.
[참고] With Shamanism, Bloodlust or Heroism grants Haste to you and one ally for 10 sec every 60 sec. Sync it with your DPS partner's burst and pop it with Doom Winds.
[제어] Hex turns the target into a frog for 1 min, incapacitating it, but damage can break it. Put it on the enemy healer and have your team attack another target.
[차단] Wind Shear interrupts a cast from 30 yds and locks that school for 4 sec. Save it for the enemy healer's heals.
[제어] Capacitor Totem explodes after 2 sec and stuns enemies within 8 yds for 3 sec. Drop it at their feet when the enemy healer and your kill target are close together.
[해제] Purge removes one beneficial magic effect from an enemy target. Strip magic protection the enemy healer applied, and remove curses from allies with Cleanse Spirit.
bg: [참고] Battleground Blitz groups run 5-6 DPS; healers carry the flag first, or a mobile DPS if none can. Keep up with and protect the carrier using Ghost Wolf, Spirit Walk and Feral Lunge.
[분담] Wind Rush Totem grants 40% movement speed for 5 sec to all allies passing within 10 yds, for 15 sec. Drop it on your flag carrier's escape route or on the path to a base.
[위치] Spirit Walk removes all movement impairing effects and increases movement speed by 60% for 8 sec. Use it when you're held by slows but need to reach a base or cart under attack.
[생존기] Healing taken is reduced by 20% in battlegrounds. Rather than waiting on heals, use Astral Shift right before the burst and block CC spells with Grounding Totem.
[제어] With Static Field Totem, you create an electric circuit enemies can't pass for 6 sec. Block the enemy flag carrier's escape route or a base entrance.
[해제] Poison Cleansing Totem removes all poisons from one ally within 30 yds every 1.5 sec for 6 sec. Drop it when poisons land on several allies stacked in a base teamfight.
pvpTalents: Shamanism, picked by 44 of the top 45 Solo Shuffle and 41 of 47 Battleground Blitz players, lets you cast Bloodlust or Heroism on yourself and one ally for 10 sec every 60 sec. Grounding Totem and Burrow, each picked by 42 of 45 Solo Shuffle players, respectively absorb harmful single-target spells aimed at allies for 3 sec and make you unattackable for 5 sec.

51514.m: Talent · 30 yd range · 1.7 sec cast · 30 sec cooldown
51514.d: Transforms the enemy into a frog for 1 min. While hexed, the victim is incapacitated, and cannot attack or cast spells. Damage may cancel the effect. Limit 1. Only works on Humanoids and Beasts.

193876.d:
Your Bloodlust / Heroism spell now has a 60 sec cooldown, but increases Haste by 15%, and only affects you and your friendly target when cast for 10 sec.

In addition, Bloodlust / Heroism is no longer affected by Sated / Exhaustion.

204336.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · 1.18% of base mana · Instant · 30 sec cooldown
204336.d: Summons a totem at your feet that will redirect all harmful spells cast within 30 yards on a nearby party or raid member to itself. Will not redirect area of effect spells. Lasts 3 sec.

355580.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · 1% of base mana · 30 yd range · Instant · 1.5 min cooldown
355580.d: Summons a totem with 4% of your health at the target location for 6 sec that forms a circuit of electricity that enemies cannot pass through.

409293.m: Tank Specs – Row 1 PvP Talent · Instant · 2 min cooldown
409293.d:
Burrow beneath the ground, becoming unattackable, removing movement impairing effects, and increasing your movement speed by 50% for 5 sec.

When the effect ends, enemies within 6 yards are knocked in the air and take [Spell Power * 6.6 * (1 + Versatility)] Physical damage.

51514.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 1.7 초 주문 시전 시간 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
51514.d: 1분 동안 적을 개구리로 변신시킵니다. 사술에 걸린 대상은 공격하거나 주문을 시전할 수 없습니다. 대상이 피해를 입으면 효과가 해제될 수 있습니다. 대상은 하나로 제한됩니다. 야수와 인간형에게만 사용할 수 있습니다.

193876.d:
피의 욕망 / 영웅심 주문의 재사용 대기시간이 60초로 변경되지만, 가속이 15%만큼 증가하고 시전 시 10초 동안 자신과 아군 대상에게만 효과가 적용됩니다.

추가로 피의 욕망 / 영웅심이 만족함 / 소진의 영향을 받지 않습니다.

204336.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 1.18% (기본 마나 중) · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
204336.d: 자신의 위치에 토템을 소환합니다. 토템은 주위 30미터 내의 파티원 또는 공격대원을 대상으로 시전되는 모든 해로운 주문을 토템에 이전합니다. 광역 주문에는 효과가 없습니다. 3초 동안 지속됩니다.

355580.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 1% (기본 마나 중) · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
355580.d: 대상 위치에 6초 동안 자신의 생명력의 4%에 해당하는 생명력을 지닌 토템을 소환합니다. 토템은 전류의 흐름을 형성하여 적이 통과하지 못하게 합니다.

409293.m: 탱커 스펙 – 1열 PvP 특성 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
409293.d:
땅속으로 잠복해 이동 방해 효과를 제거하고 5초 동안 공격받지 않는 상태가 되며 이동 속도가 50%만큼 증가합니다.

효과가 끝나면 6미터 내의 적을 공중으로 날려 보내고 [주문력 * 6.6 * (1 + 유연성)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

note: There is no spec-specific PvP guide source, so these are general principles built from ability and PvP talent tooltips, actual top-player pick rates, and mode and map requirements.

notes: 영웅 특성이 1인 조합전 폭풍인도자 41·토템술사 4로 쏠렸지만 한쪽 전용 기술(Surging Totem·Tempest 등)은 쓰지 않음
투기장 상위권 표본이 3v3 5명·2v2(한국) 4명뿐이라 투기장 줄은 1인 조합전(45명) 채택률과 일반 원칙 기준
Static Field Totem은 전장 대공세 47명 중 12명만 골라 선택 사항으로 적음
